adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, `usernames` was changed from a computed property tied to `members` to a plain controller field (`usernames: null`). In `admin_group_route.js`, `setupController` now only sets `model` and calls `model.findMembers()`; it does not reset `controller.usernames`. Since Ember route controllers are singletons, any text entered into `{{user-selector usernames=usernames}}` can persist when switching between groups. Additionally, `actions.addMembers` contains a `// TODO: should clear the input` and does not clear `this.get("usernames")` after calling `model.addMembers(...)`, so clicking Add again will resubmit the same usernames unless the user manually edits the field.
